name: oneplusone
tagline: A math skill tree that tunes its own difficulty with Elo.
summary: A browser math game climbing a real skill tree from arithmetic to Algebra I, offline, in TypeScript. Twenty-five skills with procedurally generated problems in five tiers; adaptive difficulty keeps an Elo rating per skill and aims at about 75% success; spaced repetition pulls earlier material back through dungeons, daily encounters and bosses. Pixel art and chiptune are generated from code. Pre-alpha.

ml.angle: Per-skill Elo ratings and a target success rate choose the next problem; spaced repetition schedules the review.

swe.angle: A TypeScript game with an adaptive-difficulty loop, 113 commits in.

highlights: Elo per skill, not per player, so difficulty adapts per topic and a proficiency trial gates each unlock.
Misses return as fresh problems rather than revealed answers; reduced motion, high contrast and screen-reader math are in the MVP scope.
